title: Oh No! My Bunny Has One Ear! 🐰 What's Missing? | Learn with Baby Jimmy | Crayon Babies
description:
Oh no! Baby Jimmy's crayon bunny comes alive and hops on the wall – but it has only ONE ear! 🐰 Can you find what's missing? Then Jimmy and the magic crayon draw a long pink ear, and the happy bunny hops with two ears.

🎬 What happens in this video:
🐰 Jimmy's crayon bunny wiggles and hops – with only one ear
🤔 "What's missing? Hmm?" – a little pause so you can shout the answer
🖍️ "Magic crayon, draw with me!" – Jimmy draws a long, long ear
👂 One ear, two ears! Touch your ears with Jimmy
🐇 Hop, hop, hop! Hop with me – then bye bye, bunny!

📚 Kids learn: look carefully and spot what's missing • ear • two ears • bunny • hop • touch your ears

🎶 Voices only: children singing, humming and clapping with a soft hand drum – no other musical instruments.

A fun "What's Missing?" song for toddlers and preschoolers about a bunny with one ear: look carefully, say the answer, count one and two ears and hop like a bunny with Baby Jimmy.
